source_note: English Wikipedia ('2026 United States gubernatorial elections' for races/nominees/ratings; per-state pages' General election > Polling tables for polls), via the MediaWiki parse API. Only polls whose candidate columns are all general-election nominees are kept; hypothetical/generic/primary tables are dropped. Ids: <PO>-S regular, <PO>-S2 special (senate); <PO>-G (governor). 'pct' keys equal candidate names. 'party' is a 1-letter code for D/R/I/L/G/C (DFL->D), else the party name; 'party_full' is as printed. Rows with '<1%' or unparsable values omit that entry; LV and RV versions of one poll are separate entries. No betting/prediction markets.
